class.name: NetwPredictJournalRow
class.brief_description: A detached snapshot of one journal row: the fingerprints, provenance, and flags recorded for one transition.
class.description: A copy of everything [NetwPredictJournal] knows about one transition, taken at a moment in time so it keeps answering after the row it was read from ages out of the journal ring. Every member reads whatever was true when the snapshot was taken; none of them re-consult the journal. [br][br]The evidence fields split into a pre-state half, recorded when the transition opened, and a post-state half, recorded when it closed. [method pre_fp] and [method pre_families] answer the pre-state; [method post_fp] and [method post_families] answer the post-state and read their zero defaults until the row closes. [method op], [method basis], [method episode_id], and [method write_id] are provenance: which operator write, if any, accounts for a discontinuity ahead of this row, and which episode and write recorded it.

method.name: aligned_error
method.description: The measured error at the transition an alignment reseed matched against, or [code]0.0[/code] when this row never recorded one.

method.name: attribution
method.description: This row's [enum NetwPredictJournal.Attribution], the cause assigned to its divergence, or [constant NetwPredictJournal.UNKNOWN] when none was.

method.name: basis
method.description: The write [method op] accounts for, or [code]-1[/code] when nothing wrote the body.

method.name: c_hash
method.description: The command hash recorded when this transition opened.

method.name: differing_family
method.description: This row's [enum NetwPredictJournal.StateFamily], the one state family a comparison narrowed this row's divergence to, or [constant NetwPredictJournal.FAMILY_NONE] when no comparison narrowed it to a single family.

method.name: domain
method.description: This row's [enum NetwPredictJournal.Domain]: [constant NetwPredictJournal.IN_DOMAIN] when the divergence is one recovery is expected to close, or [constant NetwPredictJournal.OUT_OF_DOMAIN] when it is not, the domain [method NetwPredictEpisodeReport.generator_domain] pins an episode's generator against.

method.name: e_digest
method.description: The environment digest recorded for this transition, or [code]0[/code] when none was recorded.

method.name: episode_id
method.description: The [method NetwPredictEpisodeReport.id] of the episode [method op] belongs to, or [code]0[/code] when [method op] names no write.

method.name: evidence_mask
method.description: The bitmask of which evidence kinds this row carries, [constant NetwPredictJournal.EVIDENCE_WITNESS] and [constant NetwPredictJournal.EVIDENCE_RAW] combined.

method.name: flags
method.description: This row's status bits, an [constant NetwPredictJournal.ROW_DIVERGENT]-style combination recording whether the row was acked, matched, substituted, superseded, found divergent, closed, chain broken, or witness matched.

method.name: kind
method.description: The drive kind this transition ran under, the raw value stamped when the row opened.

method.name: label
method.description: The command label this transition's row was opened against.

method.name: op
method.description: The operator write that accounts for a state-chain discontinuity ahead of this row, or [code]0[/code] with [method basis] at [code]-1[/code] when nothing wrote the body.

method.name: post_families
method.description: Pose, momentum, then controller, the order every family fingerprint triple is written and read in.

method.name: post_fp
method.description: The combined post-state fingerprint recorded when this transition closed, or [code]0[/code] while it has not.

method.name: pre_families
method.description: Pose, momentum, then controller, the order every family fingerprint triple is written and read in.

method.name: pre_fp
method.description: The combined pre-state fingerprint recorded when this transition opened.

method.name: raw_fp
method.description: The unclassified raw fingerprint recorded for this transition, or [code]0[/code] when none was.

method.name: topo_fp
method.description: The topology fingerprint recorded for this transition.

method.name: transition
method.description: The transition this row describes, the key it was pinned from the journal under.

method.name: witness_class_bits
method.description: What kind of contact witnessed this transition: bit [code]1[/code] a supporting body, bit [code]2[/code] static geometry, and bit [code]4[/code] a dynamic entity, combined when more than one kind witnessed at once, or [code]0[/code] when none did.

method.name: witness_fp
method.description: The witness fingerprint recorded for this transition, or [code]0[/code] when no witness evidence was recorded.

method.name: write_id
method.description: The [method NetwPredictEpisodeReport.write_id] of the write named by [method op], or [code]0[/code] when [method op] names no write.
